title: MIA Personal Node v1 shared definitions (DRAFT, ADR-0019)
description: Reusable primitives of the Personal Node protocol. Not a document type of its own. Draft by M85; implemented from M86 on.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with an explicit offset

nodeId.description: The node's id. A node is a device of the account (kind node), so this is also its device id in GET /v1/devices (M84)

nodeHost.description: Random DNS label of the node, unrelated to the account or the computer name (it is published in Certificate Transparency logs). Full name: <host>.<node zone>, e.g. nq4m7x2kd5rbt6wya.n.example

publicKey.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, base64url without padding

signature.description: Raw 64-byte Ed25519 signature, base64url without padding, over the exact signing string defined in contracts/node/v1/README.md

nonce.description: 32 random bytes, base64url without padding; single use

fingerprint.description: Human-comparable key fingerprint: RFC 4648 base32 of the first 15 bytes of SHA-256(raw public key), six groups of four

spkiPin.description: SHA-256 of the DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo of the node's TLS key, base64 (OkHttp CertificatePinner format)

argsHash.description: Same canonical-JSON SHA-256 as mvp/v1 common argsHash (ADR-0011)

dataMode.description: cloud = runtime and data in Mia cloud, the node only lends capabilities (files, local models); home = chats, memory, jobs live on the node, the cloud keeps identity, device registry, push and relay; standalone = the node is the server, the cloud is optional (relay/push only)

capabilityId.description: Known v1: files.search, files.read, apps.open, links.open, models.ollama, storage.home, runtime.full, notifications.desktop. Same vocabulary style as mvp/v1 device-access deviceCapability

nodeToolName.description: Namespaced node tool as the model sees it, e.g. node.files.search, node.files.read, node.apps.open, node.links.open

risk.description: Tool risk class, same as mvp/v1 common risk

requester.description: Who asked for the node action (ADR-0016 requester), shown in the node's local journal

nodeErrorCode.description: Errors returned by the node inside the protocol. Cloud-facing public codes (node_offline, node_revoked, …) are listed in README and are added to mvp/v1/error-codes.json by M86+

message.description: Safe, content-free text (no paths, no file content, no prompt text)

name.description: Name the user sees in «Устройства», e.g. «Домашний ПК»; editable later
